text: Preparatory direction ablation is implemented and validated under D03; see docs/benchmarks/halfflow-optimizer-experiment-v1.md. It substitutes the audited spatial chain under the existing step-scaled candidate operation. This does not implement O01 explicit regularization or fulfill its acceptance criteria: the physical penalty, derivative, complete-energy acceptance and role of Gaussian operations remain separate required work after D03. No candidate MRI fit has run and this issue remains open.
